source: 04-output/AUDIT-SUMMARY-2026-10-22.md batch 1 items 1-2; text aligned to CO-PILA-003 Payroll Scope Summary C12 / C41 / C49 (AT2 v30, verified); M32 aligned to CO-DIAN-004 M47 (WT 25819) and BAU answer of 21 Oct Q11 (FVOL wage types 25811-25815, 25823 = voluntary pension, numeral 26); verifier 2026-10-22-auditoria-lote1/LOTE1-verification.json fixes applied

edits.current: Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a return type N (correcciones) or M (mora).
edits.proposed: Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8).

edits.current: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA worker type 12 (lectiva) or 19 (productiva).
edits.proposed: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55. DISTINCT from numeral 26. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types 25811-25815 and 25823 and the institutional-plan wage types 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803 and 65804 - each of which carries exactly one of the two attributes, art. 55 (numeral 25) or art. 126-1 (numeral 26). A combined APV total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.
edits.proposed: Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.12.9. DISTINCT from numeral 26 (voluntary contributions to a voluntary pension fund, ET art. 126-1). Source: wage type 25819 Voluntary Contribution to Mandatory Pension Plan, the same source as Form 220 casilla 55; the voluntary-fund ('FVOL') wage types 25811-25815 and 25823 feed numeral 26. A combined voluntary-pension total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823, and 21141 for retirees) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 21212, 65803, 65804). Only the amount actually deducted from the employee's labour income in the employee's name is reported here, the rule of Form 220 casilla 56 (ET art. 126-1; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41); employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from them through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804), which also comes from the WTC. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
edits.proposed: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41. DISTINCT from numeral 25 (voluntary contributions to the RAIS, ET art. 55). Source: the voluntary-fund ('FVOL') wage types 25811-25815, 25823 and, for retirees, 21141, the same source as Form 220 casilla 56; the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 21212, 65803, 65804) are reported here only for the amount deducted from the employee's labour income in the employee's name, the rule of Form 220 casilla 56 (ET art. 126-1; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41); employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type, which comes from the WTC. A combined voluntary-pension total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
